title: taylordrayson.com Portable Text dialect
description: The subset of Portable Text stored in articles.content and pages.content, enforced server-side by App\Rules\ValidPortableText. Authoring clients (Glaze, MCP tools, Shortcuts) should produce documents matching this schema.

oneOf.description: A dynamic tag used as a link target. `tag` must be registered and declare the `href` placement (e.g. site.social), or the document fails to save.

items.description: One of the decorators strong, em, code, underline, strike-through, or the _key of a markDef on the same node.

dynamicTagNode.description: A dynamic tag used inline as a span. `tag` must be registered and declare the `inline` placement, or the document fails to save.

tagName.description: A dotted path into the server's dynamic tag registry, e.g. entries.count, ambient.location.city, streak.longest. Validated against the registry at save time; an unregistered name is rejected.

tagOptions.description: Keys are option names the tag declares (see the tag's own definition); values must be one of its declared choices, except `period`, which also accepts a bare four-digit year (e.g. "2025") alongside its named presets.

textBlock.description: children may be empty only when listItem is set: the editor produces an empty list item the moment a list is started, before the author has typed into it.

url.description: Absolute URL, or a root-relative path (e.g. /storage/...) for own-hosted media.

width.description: Intrinsic pixel width. Send when known: lets the renderer branch portrait/landscape layout and reserve space while loading. Omitted or explicit null are both accepted.

height.description: Intrinsic pixel height. Send together with width. Omitted or explicit null are both accepted.

oneOf.description: A dynamic tag used as an image source (e.g. entries.photo) instead of a stored url. `tag` must declare the `image` placement.

language.description: Highlighted when one of: bash, css, javascript, json, php, sql, typescript, xml, yaml. Other values render as plain text. Shown as a label in the block header. Omitted or explicit null are both accepted.

filename.description: Optional filename shown in the block header, e.g. app/Models/Article.php. Omitted or explicit null are both accepted.

lineNumbers.description: Render a line-number gutter when true. Defaults to false. Omitted or explicit null are both accepted.

variant.description: GitHub-alert style variant set. Renders as a tinted panel with a bold uppercase label for the variant name.

url.description: Absolute URL, or a root-relative path (e.g. /storage/...) for own-hosted media. A YouTube or Vimeo URL renders as that host's player, loaded only once the reader presses play; anything else renders as a native <video controls> element.

poster.description: Absolute URL, or a root-relative path, for the still shown before playback. Omit for a YouTube video and its published thumbnail is used.

width.description: Intrinsic pixel width. Send when known, same as image. Omitted or explicit null are both accepted.

height.description: Intrinsic pixel height. Send together with width. Omitted or explicit null are both accepted.
